# z-localization map subset

Unmodified map/statistics/state sources from mozihe/z-localization, commit
`76e126328b670adc92981d9b4900cc059a6f2343`. Original license: GNU GPL version 2;
see LICENSE. Source identities are recorded in UPSTREAM.json.

This component is compiled only with SMALL_POINT_LIO_ZLIO_MAP=ON. The optional
combined build includes this GPL component; the existing MIT copyright notices
remain on the original Small Point-LIO files. No upstream ROS node is included.
